context: Sho and Yumiko talk about Dad.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (パパ/奥さん/鼻/駄目/言い方) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、パパはいつ帰るの?
lines.style: curious small child voice, bright warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: パパは、もうすぐ帰ってくるわよ。
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、風邪で鼻が赤かったよ。
lines.en: Dad's nose was red from a cold.
lines.style: observant small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、無理しちゃ駄目ねって言わなきゃ。
lines.en: Oh, I have to tell him not to overdo it.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 隣の奥さんも、心配してたよ。
lines.en: The lady next door was worried too.
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あの奥さん、優しい言い方をするわよね。
lines.en: That lady speaks in a kind way.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: きつい言い方は、駄目だもんね。
lines.en: A harsh way of saying things is no good.
lines.style: earnest small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうね。パパに、優しくしてあげてね。
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
